notes.title: Announcing NEON INFERNO, Zenovia Interactive's next game!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-tXBjDuORl8;full][/previewyoutube]

After several years of development, Zenovia Interactive is proud to announce our next game, Neon Inferno! It is now available to wishlist on Steam and will be releasing in 2025: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957720/Neon_Inferno/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2957720/Neon_Inferno/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/a4d519d4de25afb47c0a34ac08c13055193b22d3.jpg

Three decades from now, New York City is at war with itself. A war with no battlefield: criminal syndicates control four of its five boroughs, fighting each other and the corrupt NYPD in a vicious struggle for supremacy. Into this dystopia steps a fledgling crime family trying to secure their place, striving for power just as everyone else. You are their deadliest weapon.

 Shoot close, aim far: A dynamic blend of side-scroller and gallery-shooter, where the action takes place in both foreground and background (like playing Contra and Wild Guns at the same time).
 Glorious 32-bit style: A sci-fi cityscape rendered in beautiful pixel art and backed by an evocative soundtrack.
 Two-player co-op: With danger lurking around every street corner, wouldn't you be better off with a friend?
 Satisfying arcade challenge: Enjoy a playthrough on an easier mode... or put your skills and resilience to the test with the 1-credit-clear Arcade Mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/fc1d0d13d23d60fdc18bdfc28e896e63b716b6f3.gif

As an assassin, your missions will take you through every area of this hyper-metropolitan sprawl: from the impoverished battle-torn slums of The Bronx, where the police and the gangs wage vicious war covering entire neighborhoods in flame, to the walled neon gardens of Inner Manhattan, where the upper-class and the lawmakers idle away their time enjoying the fruits of high culture, blissfully shielded from the chaos and the agony of the outside world — for now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/644a1012d748cda5385453bebee75c5cb7021212.jpg

Thank you so much for your continued support throughout all these years, and we look forward to blowing your minds with this next game.

Sri Kankanahalli
Creative director, Zenovia Interactive

notes.title: Explosive Content Update for Steel Assault! +[20% discount for a limited time]
notes.content:
Free Steel Assault Soundtrack

Good news everyone! We heard from the community, we read the reviews and since people dig the Steel Assault soundtrack so much, we decided to give it away for free! 
You get 18 powerful tracks mixing rock, chiptune and industrial music with an additional FM-synthesized remix album of all tracks. 


Difficulty balancing

The developing team at Zenovia Interactive and Tribute Games have calibrated the difficulty and made precise adjustments to the base game of Steel Assault, more precisely its normal difficulty mode.

It’s important to understand that Steel Assault’s original game was designed around Hard Mode. The Previous Normal Mode was a less painful expression of the core game experience, bridging the gap between easy (for 1st time platformer players) and hard (for the true mastery of the genre). This original normal mode leaned too close to easy, a little too far from the authentic “retro hard” experience envisioned by Sri Kankanahalli the creator/designer of Steel Assault. 

The hard and the arcade mode remain unaffected by this update. So all you platformer aficionados and speedruns can rest assured that your records remain valid.


Modification list

*Restore damage to the levels of Hard and Arcade (i.e. x2 damage, keeping health restore between sub-stages, and additional health items

*Slight health increases on certains enemies and bosses (Flame Spider, Dragonfly Mech, Theta Hydron, Nanohazard, Server Wall…)

*Slight timing changes and respawn time  in certain enemies

We hope to get to see some of your speedruns and your no damage perfect runs! Don't hesitate to share them with us on our Discord server or social media.

The Steel Assault Team

notes.title: 📢 Steel Assault: OUT NOW on PC, Mac & Linux! 📢 + 10% launch discount!

Steel Assault is available TODAY on Steam (and Nintendo Switch) for PC, Mac and Linux
Thank you so much to our Kickstarter backers and for everyone who has been following the developement of this game over the years. We hope you enjoy the final result! Yes, we heard you Mac and Linux players and we got a version ready for both operating systems. :) 

We are also having a 10% launch discount on the price of the game. Discount valid only for a week! 

Have a look at the brand new launch trailer: 
[previewyoutube=PSf58gdXuCY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]




Some Backstory
"A post-apocalyptic America", "the dictator who lords over the ashes", "2046"? but what really happened before the timeline of the game? We were thinking you might enjoy some key dates to better understand the world of Steel Assault. 


 August 2036: Black Widow Event (thorium-based radiation attack which rendered America’s cities uninhabitable)
 September 2036: Start of Second Pacific War
 February 2038: End of Second Pacific War. Magnus Pierce becomes dictator over the ashes of America
 December 2044: Large-scale purge of dissenting govt. officials (including Taro’s parents)
 January 2045: Formation of Daybreak Resistance, an underground movement to topple Gen. Magnus Pierce's regime
 April 2046: Taro Takahashi, resistance soldier, is sent to Washington, D.C. to investigate suspicious activity
 Today: The day you join the Resistance! 🦾

notes.title: New Patch for the Demo: Readability + Balance Update!
notes.content:
Following the detailed and very welcomed feedback we got from players who've tried the demo so far, we decided to push a new patch for the demo. This patch only addresses some of the feedback we got. 

List of Changes

 Backgrounds have been toned down in Sea Invasion, Times Square, and TS Helicopter sections
 All enemies take slightly longer to telegraph their attacks, and you have slightly more room for leeway dealing with them
 Visual distinction between cancellable and non-cancellable bullets: non-cancellable bullets flash between blue and orange
 Recharge time for "Slide" action is reduced slightly
 Jetpack soldiers stop before firing their attack
 Normal mode: Player no longer starts the stage on the minigun
 Minor bugfixes


Here's a Before/After comparison image to show the new toned down background to improve visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/f6a84328154db66afc6b64f462a3f47226901f2e.png

ICYMI: Steel Assault Playable Demo
In case you've missed our previous announcement, a first demo is now available for the post-apocalyptic 16-bit retro-style action platformer! Play the demo during this Steam Game Festival, ending soon! Get more information on the demo in our previous announcement. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280300/Steel_Assault/

Feedback
We would love to hear what your thoughts are on the improvements we've made so far. You can let the devs know what you think by posting on the Steam Community Hub of Steel Assault or by chatting with the devs in the #steel-assault channel on the Tribute Discord.  Of course we could not address all the feedback we got so far as there are things that require more time to change/fix/improve, but we hope you like what we've worked on so far!

notes.title: Playable Demo is Here! + Live Stream on Friday Feb 5th!
notes.content:
Steel Assault Playable Demo
The hype is real! A first demo is now available for the post-apocalyptic 16-bit retro-style action platformer! Play the demo and join us on a live stream Friday 4 PM (ET) on the store page. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280300/Steel_Assault/

Jumping right into the action!
We wanted to give you a real taste of the gameplay so this demo is not the first level of the game! This part is set in the Sunken City of Manhattan which you would visit at a later time when playing the full game. You'll be able to try out different styles of gameplay available throughout the game. Enjoy the acclaimed gameplay trailer track as you make your way through the devastated lands of New York City!

For a limited time!
The demo will only be available for the duration of the Steam Game Festival. Make sure you try it by February 9, 2021 at 10am PST.

Difficulty Settings
You'll learn how to play the game with die & retry, just as you did in your childhood. (If you didn't learn that way as a child, then don't mind us, we are old, okaaayy!? Don't rub it in...TT_TT) However, the demo still has 2 different difficulty settings: Arcade & Normal. 

Arcade Mode: Looking for a challenge? You're at the right place. 
Normal: Looking for something a bit easier but still challenging? Normal mode is for you!

Video, Controls & Audio Settings
The demo has custom settings you can set to your preference. You can remap inputs for your controller as well as adjust Music vs SFX balance. Not so much into the CRT/scanlines effect? You can remove the effect in Options > Video. 

The game window ratio is the as a retro 4:3 monitor. This is the only game ratio available for the demo. You can change the size of the window of the game if you wish. 

Live Stream Friday 4 PM (ET)
Meet members of the team this Friday, February 5th at 4 PM (ET). We will be streaming the demo on the Steel Assault store page. Game designer Sri Kankanahalli from Zenovia will be talking about the game's development process with Sandrine and Eric from Tribute. We'll be paying attention to the chat so come over to ask your questions or just hang out. 
You can set a reminder on this announcement page (on the right!). 

Feedback
We're happy to hear about your impressions of the demo. You can let the devs know what you think by posting on the Steam Community Hub of Steel Assault or by chatting with the devs in the #steel-assault channel on the Tribute Discord.

Let's keep in touch!
If you like what you see and/or would like to get updates on the game development and release, consider following Tribute Games' Twitter or Facebook pages.

There's also this wonderful option offered by Steam where you can Follow The Game to get only the most crucial updates on your Steam activity feed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37998910/012196b04024fc7fa1a8176cd9fe1bf0384b8cf2.gif

And of course, do not forget to add the game to your wishlist!
